# Hugging Face

> > The AI community platform for building, training, and deploying machine learning models with open-source tools and collaborative resources.

Hugging Face provides state-of-the-art libraries like transformers, diffusers, and Gradio, alongside the Hugging Face Hub for sharing models and datasets. The platform serves researchers, developers, and organizations working with LLMs, vision models, robotics, and multimodal AI.

## Key Topics

- transformers library
- Hugging Face Hub
- model training and fine-tuning
- model quantization
- inference optimization
- speculative decoding
- LLMs (Large Language Models)
- Llama models
- DeepSeek-R1
- WebGPU and browser ML
- Gradio UI framework
- diffusers library
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- chain-of-thought reasoning
- open-source AI

## Learning Resources & Courses

- [Welcome to the 🤗 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/mcp-course): Model Context Protocol course by Hugging Face and Anthropic

## Model Training & Optimization

- [GaLore: Advancing Large Model Training on Consumer-grade Hardware](https://huggingface.co/blog/galore): GaLore: Memory-efficient LLM training on consumer hardware
- [Training and Finetuning Sparse Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers v5](https://huggingface.co/blog/train-sparse-encoder): Sparse embedding training with Sentence Transformers v5 and SPLADE
- [Memory-efficient Diffusion Transformers with Quanto and Diffusers](https://huggingface.co/blog/quanto-diffusers): Quanto quantization for memory-efficient Stable Diffusion 3 models
- [Introducing Trackio: A Lightweight Experiment Tracking Library from Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blog/trackio): Trackio: Lightweight ML experiment tracking library by Hugging Face

## Inference & Performance

- [Faster Text Generation with Self-Speculative Decoding](https://huggingface.co/blog/layerskip): LayerSkip: Self-speculative decoding for faster LLM inference
- [Hugging Face Text Generation Inference available for AWS Inferentia2](https://huggingface.co/blog/text-generation-inference-on-inferentia2): Text Generation Inference (TGI) now supports AWS Inferentia2
- [Accelerating Qwen3-8B Agent on Intel® Core™ Ultra with Depth-Pruned Draft Models](https://huggingface.co/blog/intel-qwen3-agent): Qwen3-8B acceleration on Intel Core Ultra via depth-pruned drafts
- [Tricks from OpenAI gpt-oss YOU 🫵 can use with transformers](https://huggingface.co/blog/faster-transformers): OpenAI GPT-OSS optimization tricks for Hugging Face transformers
